dialogues.speaker: Blue Bolt
dialogues.text: #Want to chat for a bit, {NICKNAME}? Or are you just bursting with inspiration to command the guard unit in a few more trial runs?

response.speaker: Blue Bolt
response.text: Sproutie's really adorable, isn't it? It's also my trusty partner — Miss Yelan was the one who gave it to me!

response.speaker: Blue Bolt
response.text: There's one thing I still don't quite get, though. Just how did this... incredible weasel that lives underground in Liyue... come to follow Miss Yelan, and become so obedient to her to boot?

response.speaker: Blue Bolt
response.text: But now, Sproutie and I have developed a strong mutual understanding too. I dare say we can read each other's minds, even!

response.speaker: Blue Bolt
response.text: When I was in Natlan, my Yumkasaurus companion also got along really well with Sproutie.

response.speaker: Blue Bolt
response.text: If you're ever back in Natlan, you're welcome to come by my stall over there anytime!

response.speaker: Blue Bolt
response.text: About Miss Yelan?

response.speaker: Blue Bolt
response.text: I delivered several big orders for her not too long ago. I had to take a huge detour to avoid multiple threats just to get some important samples to Liyue.

response.speaker: Blue Bolt
response.text: Looking back, it was also during a detour I took to avoid my nemeses that I caught Miss Yelan's eye.

response.speaker: Blue Bolt
response.text: Yeah... Alright, my bad. "Nemeses" might be a bit of an exaggeration, to be fair.

response.speaker: Blue Bolt
response.text: Back in my younger, brasher days, I didn't play by the rules and kept snatching up orders, so the whole industry ended up blacklisting me. I had all this talent for high-speed delivery, but absolutely nowhere to use it.

response.speaker: Blue Bolt
response.text: To keep a low profile, whenever I had to make a run from Teticpac Peak to the Flower-Feather Clan, I'd choose to take the longer route via the Sulfurous Veins.

response.speaker: Blue Bolt
response.text: This became a habit of mine. As it turns out, it was exactly what Miss Yelan needed. I managed to build a new branch of business for her in foreign lands, quite by accident too.

response.speaker: Blue Bolt
response.text: This is why I'll always remember the encouraging words Miss Yelan once said to me...

response.speaker: Blue Bolt
response.text: Sometimes, the twists and turns of life lead you to opportunities you wouldn't have had otherwise. So never lose your zest for life, no matter what!

choices.text: That's a lot of fire and passion in those words.

response.speaker: Blue Bolt
response.text: Heh heh, Miss Yelan didn't exactly say all that, of course. That's just me paraphrasing her... with more emotional and creative color!

response.speaker: Blue Bolt
response.text: As you both know, Miss Yelan is always oh-so-mysterious. She comes and goes like a ghost, and always speaks so coolly that she might as well be a tall glass of iced water.

response.speaker: Blue Bolt
response.text: She said I should go apologize and make amends with the old-timers whose toes I'd stepped on. I think so, too.

response.speaker: Blue Bolt
response.text: Now, I'm in a much better headspace than I used to be. Once I finish delivering this order, I'll do exactly as she said!

choices.text: I never thought Yelan would encourage people like this!

response.speaker: Blue Bolt
response.text: Ah, the Master... Hats off to her!

response.speaker: Blue Bolt
response.text: I've managed to build up a pretty good network of connections here, thanks to a bunch of helpful tips from Miss Yelan. It was through that network that I was slowly introduced to the Whiz-Kid.

response.speaker: Blue Bolt
response.text: Once she was sure I didn't have any... twisted ideas about using her gadgets to hurt innocent people, she finally agreed to my request.

response.speaker: Blue Bolt
response.text: Also, they make the best krumkake at the craftshop!

response.speaker: Blue Bolt
response.text: I bet that if one day she decides to open up a krumkake store in Natlan, she'll become the next big star in the food and beverage business!

response.speaker: Blue Bolt
response.text: See you!

response.speaker: Observe Sproutie
response.text: (It doesn't look like this little weasel has been praised like this before — there's a look of shyness in its eyes...)

choices.text: You handsome weasel! Let's do great things together!

response.speaker: Observe Sproutie
response.text: (This little weasel seems really encouraged — its eyes are sparkling with determination...)

response.speaker: Observe Sproutie
response.text: (The little weasel seems unusually calm — it's just staring at you as you walk away...)
